entries.리듬 입력의 타이밍과 정확도가 공격, 회피, 스킬 발동을 직접 결정하는: A rhythm action RPG where the timing and accuracy of your rhythm inputs directly drive attacks, dodges and skills. Every note you hit lands as a combat hit, and combos and Fever make the battle explode.
entries.Project L은 단순 점수 경쟁보다, 리듬 판정이 전투 결과와 캐릭터: Rather than simple score chasing, Project L ties rhythm judgments directly to combat results and character growth.
A song's structure (intro, drop, outro) is tied to the boss's patterns.
entries.Tap, Hold, Flick, Slide, Drag 입력이 공격, 방어: Tap, Hold, Flick, Slide and Drag inputs turn into attacks, defense, dodges and skills.
Input streaks build into score multipliers, attack bonuses and Fever Time.
entries.캐릭터 레벨, 장비 강화, 스킬 트리, 곡 해금으로 장기 플레이를 만듭니: Character levels, gear upgrades, skill trees and song unlocks keep you playing for the long haul.
entries.입력 하나가 전투 행동이 된다: Every input becomes a combat action
entries.전투 입력 설명을 한 장씩 넘겨 보며 확인할 수 있습니다. 좌우 화살표를: Flip through the combat inputs one card at a time. Press the left/right arrows to see the next input type along with its tutorial image.
Press once as the note reaches the judgment line to trigger a basic attack.
entries.출시 버전 기준 4종 캐릭터가 제공되며, 리듬 입력 방식은 같지만 전투: 4 characters are available at launch. They share the same rhythm inputs but differ in combat chain effects and growth paths.
entries.리듬 게임의 접근성을 유지하면서 RPG 성장과 멀티플레이 경쟁 요소를 더: Keeps rhythm games accessible while adding RPG progression and multiplayer competition.
entries.리소넌트와 노이즈의 세계: A world of Resonants and Noise
entries.현대와 판타지가 섞인 근미래 세계에서, 음악을 왜곡하는 노이즈와 이를 정: In a near-future world blending the modern and the fantastic, meet the Noise that distorts music and the Resonants who purify it.
Hold the key while the note is active to guard or prepare a charge attack.
Flick quickly in the indicated direction to dodge the boss's dangerous attacks.
Input continuously along the path to chain multi-hit attacks.
Hold and drag along the path to fill the skill gauge and ready a powerful skill.
As long as the rhythm keeps going, this fight isn't over.
entries.공격과 방어가 균형 잡힌 기본형 캐릭터입니다. 초반 조작 학습과 안정적인: A standard character with balanced attack and defense. Ideal for learning the controls early on and for steady story progress.
Just give me one beat, and I'll finish the next attack.
entries.공격력이 높지만 체력이 낮아 정확한 입력이 중요합니다. Perfect 판: High attack but low HP, so precise input matters. Big rewards for Perfect judgments and keeping combos going.
Don't lose the flow. I'll keep the beat for you.
entries.콤보 유지와 회복에 특화되어 협동 모드에 적합합니다. 아군 보조와 게이지: Specializes in keeping combos alive and healing, making them a great fit for Co-op mode. Excels at supporting allies and managing gauges.
It's okay to falter. I'll hold the beat.
entries.체력과 방어력이 높아 생존 플레이에 강합니다. Miss 이후 피해를 줄이: High HP and defense make for strong survival play. Takes less damage after a Miss and steadily withstands boss patterns.
entries.주인공이 리소넌트로 각성하고, 사일런트 존을 정화하며 노이즈의 근원을 추: The main campaign: the protagonist awakens as a Resonant, purifies Silent Zones and tracks down the source of the Noise.
entries.같은 곡 또는 지정 곡에서 정확도, 콤보, 피버 운용을 겨루는 경쟁형 모: A competitive mode where players go head to head on accuracy, combos and Fever management on the same or a designated song.
entries.최대 2인이 각자 캐릭터를 선택하고 동일 스테이지를 함께 공략하며 파티: Up to 2 players each pick a character and take on the same stage together, making use of party synergy bonuses.
entries.시즌 미션, 한정 장비, 이벤트 스킨, 배틀패스 보상으로 장기 플레이 동: Season missions, limited gear, event skins and Battle Pass rewards give you reasons to keep playing.
Beings who attune the world's energy through sound.
Hostile entities that distort music and consume the world.
Areas consumed by the Noise that only Resonants can purify.
